other_conditions: The applicant must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
The applicant must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal.
The member must have served the board for at least 5 years.
The pension is payable only after the member has completed 60 years of age.
In case of death of the beneficiary, the spouse or nominee is entitled to a family pension equal to half of the pension amount the beneficiary was receiving.
benefits_summary: Monthly pension ranging from ₹750 to ₹1120, with a family pension of half that amount payable to the spouse/nominee upon the beneficiary's death.
